utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s changing a bit this week. I can fill you in if you need the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, can you confirm what changed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, the pickup spot moved to the church lot, and the afternoon run is leaving ten minutes earlier this week.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can handle the carpool. I’ll tell everyone the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. I’ll keep an eye out in case anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I can take Tuesday if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’ll take Wednesday if nobody else has it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Wednesday works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that if you want to coordinate pickups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks. I can help coordinate the pickups and keep track of who has what.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, thanks. I’ll keep track of the pickups with you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure, I can take the later pickup if that helps with school drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, thanks. I’ll sort the school drop-off around your later pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll handle pickup and keep things synced on my end.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, let’s keep it simple: what time are we leaving, and who’s riding with whom?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Let me think... I’m pretty sure we said 8, and I’ll ride with whoever needs the extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me. Eight works, and I’ll keep my seat open for whoever needs it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m happy to help with the carpool if you want me to spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help, thanks. Could you make sure people know the pickup times too?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the pickup times when I spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there was a change, but I’m not sure what time they want us there. Did Rosa say anything more?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: She said to plan on 8:30. I’ll send the updated pickup order now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks. I’ll watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, what time do you need the carpool to leave?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tomorrow at 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ll plan for 7:30 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can take my turn this week, if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, that still helps. I can take the later slot if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, thanks. I can still do this week.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina. I can help with the carpool schedule if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What time did you want to start the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: How about we start around 7:30? That gives us a little buffer in case anyone’s running late.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of it if you tell me where the carpool is meeting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the church parking lot around 7. I can send the exact spot if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, that helps. Send the exact spot if you can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with that carpool schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks. I’ll send over my part of the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, send it over and I’ll line up my part.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m okay with carpooling, but I need to know the pickup time and how many stops we’re making first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the pickup time and how many stops there will be?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can confirm once you tell me the pickup time and how many stops there are.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can take a seat if you want, Mara. Just let me know what time the carpool needs to leave.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ll let you know the time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — just send me the time and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the carpool. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring the cooler and some extra cups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll handle the snacks and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool’s been a little shuffled this week, so I’m checking who’s driving when. I’ll let you know as soon as I have the full rundown.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess. Just keep me posted on who’s driving each day so I can line things up here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep you posted as I hear who’s driving each day.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’m in for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I’ll add you to the pickup list and send the route details soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks. Send me the route when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can handle the carpool this week.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll take the next one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good. I’ll keep you posted on the schedule for next week.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Nell — I can put the carpool on the list and see who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn. Just let me know who can take it and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll check who can take it and let you know as soon as I have names.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that. What time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s aim for 8:00 sharp. That gives us a little cushion.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: 8:00 sharp works for me. I’ll keep that in mind.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I plan on for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you give me the address? I’ll check the timing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s 123 Maple Street. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can take the kids if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira. I might still need to swap a day or two, but that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem, just let me know which days need swapping and I’ll work around it.
